data: Você pousa no chão para descansar seu corpo. Ao ativar este movimento, sua velocidade de voo se torna zero e você perde o tipo voador enquanto permanecer no solo. No início do seu próximo turno, se não tiver deixado o chão, recupere {dice} de pontos de vida.
Makes the audience quickly grow bored when an appeal move has little effect.
Moves that get 2 Appeal points or less do not increase the crowd meter until the end of your next turn.

You land on the ground to rest your body. When you activate this move, your Fly Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn, and you recover {dice} hit points. In addition, you lose your Flying type when you land, and do not regain it for as long as you remain on the ground.
Healing applies immediately, and amount is buffed.
